entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: Bengal Renaissance, a transformative movement in Bangladesh (1793–1858). Emerged from Great Bengal Famine kills an estimated 10 million people under Company misrule and Battle of Plassey and Company Raj. Catalyzed Ram Mohan Roy campaigns to abolish sati, leading to its ban by Lord Bentinck and Partition of Bengal 1905 and Swadeshi Movement.
